liste.title: Choose a file
liste.intro: Each row shows the next intervention to explore for a partner.
liste.first: Search for a name or filter files by step.
liste.second: Open the file to find the promised services and their preview.

dossier.title: Understand what still needs preparation
dossier.intro: The file brings together the services planned for one partner.
dossier.first: The website presentation and Facebook publication have separate views.
dossier.second: The next intervention opens the relevant screen; history remains available under Other actions.

contenu.title: Review the message and its appearance
contenu.intro: Examine the text, visual and link together before continuing.
contenu.first: A check row opens the element to review or edit.
contenu.second: The preview shows your current draft. Editing content does not confirm any consent.

autorisation.title: Understand the scope of consent
autorisation.intro: Connect consent to the right contact, reviewed content and intended channel.
autorisation.first: Open the email, conditions or contact to read the examples provided.
autorisation.second: The confirmation screen lets you review consent; the demo creates no real consent.

publication.title: Prepare the destination and timing
publication.intro: The recap brings together the exact content, destination and proposed date.
publication.first: Choose a date and time zone in scheduling, then review the recap.
publication.second: Real sending remains disabled. Result tracking lets you explore the following screens.

corriger.title: Adjust the local draft
corriger.intro: The tabs let you edit one element at a time with its appearance alongside.
corriger.first: Text, link, image and option changes update the preview only.
corriger.second: Keep the draft to continue exploring, then return to the step you came from.

historique.title: Find the context of a change
historique.intro: The timeline contains fictional events for exploring version history.
historique.first: Choose a filter and then an event to read its details.
historique.second: Comparison helps you review two versions; it does not restore published content.

details.title: Examine the detail before returning
details.intro: This view explores part of the file while keeping its context.
details.first: Fields let you prepare or explore a local example.
details.second: Back returns to the originating view. External operations remain disabled.
